text: PART III - LANDS Title Registration REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998 Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14 BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby declare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land Nos. 1:19, 1:20, 1:31, 1:38, 1:44, 1:54, 1:80, 1:81, 1:91, 1:98, 1:103, 1:108, 1:109, 1:110, 1:111, 1:119 of Block 8, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 620530, situated in the Village of Walalgoda, within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 212 B - Jandura in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Ambilipitiya, in the District of Rathnapura, in the Province of Sabaragamuwa, referred to in Notice No. 62/0824 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 2405/09 of 07th October, 2024 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998. P.C.D. SIGERA, Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 16th May, 2025
